rule: Leave target seed out. Enumerate all m-subsets of the other nine seeds. Select M1 iff arithmetic mean of their earlier-period NSE(M1)-NSE(B0) is strictly positive. Ties select B0.
deployment: Use one independently trained target seed's later-period prediction; no prediction ensemble.
aggregation: Equal subsets within target, equal target seeds, equal basins. Report gains against fixed B0 and fixed M1, basin medians, per-target and per-basin distributions and selection probabilities.
audit: m=1 must reproduce original other_vs_B0 and other_vs_M1. Independent direct enumeration must match vectorized results. Entire input/output artifacts hashed.
uncertainty: Descriptive finite-pool cross-evaluation. No new p-values or confidence intervals from overlapping subsets; target/region summaries are dependent sensitivity descriptions, not independent replicates.
interpretation: Report all four m values. Do not select a winning m from later Test scores. Selection stability alone is not evidence of improved predictive value. This analysis does not redefine the confirmed primary endpoint.
